title: AISE shared contract primitives (v1.0)
description: Device-neutral building blocks reused by every AISE interchange contract. This document is a library of definitions; it is not a standalone payload schema. Identifiers are UUIDs so both platforms can generate them offline without coordination. Timestamps are RFC 3339 UTC strings. Content hashes are lowercase SHA-256 hex.

epistemicState.title: Epistemic state of an assertion
epistemicState.description: Distinct truth statuses for consequential model assertions (architecture-lock 2). There is deliberately no CONFIRMED_ABSENT value in this vocabulary.

observationPresence.title: Observation presence
observationPresence.description: Coverage/absence states. These must never be encoded as confirmed absence; there is no CONFIRMED_ABSENT value in this vocabulary (architecture-lock 2).

confidence.title: Model confidence (0..1)
confidence.description: A model-probability score. Never a substitute for measurement uncertainty (requirements REQ-008).

plusMinus.title: Plus/minus magnitude in the stated unit

unit.title: Unit of the plus/minus magnitude (same unit as the measurement value)

measurement.title: Measurement/estimate transport record
measurement.description: Transport fields for measured or estimated quantities. kind distinguishes measurements from estimates so an estimate can never silently pose as a measurement (architecture-lock 3). confidence and uncertainty are separate fields (requirements REQ-008).

unit.title: Unit of the value (required even for estimates)

confidence.title: Model confidence where available (separate from uncertainty)

method.title: How the value was obtained (opaque method reference)
